implementation.targetScope: The Resvg(svg, {fitTo}).render().asPng() caller in VentiMath functions/src/writeupPicture.ts. Shared repository-owned scan conversion, path geometry and PNG encoder extracted from VLX; no upstream renderer code or native binary copied.

differences: Only the generated handwriting SVG vocabulary is public: svg, g, rect and absolute M/L/H/V/Q/C/Z paths, opaque colors and round/butt strokes. Unsupported visual semantics throw.
No CSS, fonts, filters, remote resources, crop, asynchronous worker or general SVG DOM API.
Antialiasing and PNG bytes differ; dimensions and ink placement are compared against upstream.
Public output exposes width, height and asPng; other upstream inspection APIs are outside the used scope.
The internal raster/paths/png exports are shared VLX implementation interfaces, not general SVG contracts.
App adoption requires a separate URL repin; source completion is not deployment.

verification.pixelControls: 66 synthetic paper/pen cases on Node/Bun; 18 additional synthetic pages through unchanged private app layout/caller, with no student data exported.
